```{r setup,message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
```

```{r}
master <- read_csv("../data/processed/master_dataset.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    rural_urban = factor(rural_urban, levels = c("Rural", "Urban")),

    drd_category = factor(drd_category,
      levels = c(
        "LSOAs never ranked in top 50 most deprived",
        "LSOAs sometimes in the top 50 most deprived",
        "LSOAs often in the top 50 most deprived",
        "LSOAs in Deep-rooted deprivation"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE)
  )

cat("Master loaded:", nrow(master), "rows\n")
cat("Rural:", sum(master$rural_urban == "Rural"),
    "| Urban:", sum(master$rural_urban == "Urban"), "\n")

```

```{r}
table(master$drd_category, master$rural_urban)
```

```{r}
prop.table(
  table(master$drd_category, master$rural_urban),
  margin = 1
) %>%
  round(3) * 100

```
```{r}
master %>%
  group_by(rural_urban, drd_category) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = rural_urban,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total     = Rural + Urban,
    pct_rural = round(100 * Rural / total, 1),
    pct_urban = round(100 * Urban / total, 1)
  )

```

```{r}
master %>%
  filter(
    drd_category == "LSOAs in Deep-rooted deprivation",
    rural_urban  == "Rural"
  ) %>%
  select(
    lsoa_name, la_name, ruc_name,
    wimd_2025_rank,
    income_rank,      # Low income rank = income-deprived (urban-type)
    access_rank,      # Low access rank = access-deprived (rural-type)
    housing_rank,
    employment_rank,
    health_rank
  )

```

```{r}
master %>%
  filter(drd_category == "LSOAs in Deep-rooted deprivation") %>%
  group_by(rural_urban) %>%
  summarise(
    n                   = n(),
    median_overall_rank = median(wimd_2025_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_income_rank  = median(income_rank,    na.rm = TRUE),
    median_access_rank  = median(access_rank,    na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}
master %>%
  filter(
    rural_urban    == "Rural",
    access_rank    <= 192,      # Worst 10% on access to services
    wimd_2025_rank >  50        # But NOT in the overall top 50
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    count               = n(),
    median_overall_rank = median(wimd_2025_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_access_rank  = median(access_rank,    na.rm = TRUE),
    median_income_rank  = median(income_rank,    na.rm = TRUE)
  )

```

```{r}
master %>%
  filter(
    rural_urban    == "Rural",
    access_rank    <= 192,
    wimd_2025_rank >  50
  ) %>%
  count(la_name, sort = TRUE)

```

```{r}
master %>%
  filter(rural_urban == "Rural") %>%
  mutate(
    access_group = if_else(
      access_rank <= 192,
      "Severely access-deprived (worst 10%)",
      "Not severely access-deprived"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(access_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n                    = n(),
    median_overall_rank  = median(wimd_2025_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_income_rank   = median(income_rank,    na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_worst20_overall  = round(100 * mean(wimd_2025_rank <= 383), 1),
    pct_top50_overall    = round(100 * mean(wimd_2025_rank <= 50),  1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}
master %>%
  filter(rural_urban == "Rural") %>%
  mutate(
    deprivation_type = case_when(
      access_rank <= 383 & income_rank <= 383 ~ "Both access AND income deprived",
      access_rank <= 383 & income_rank >  383 ~ "Access deprived only",
      access_rank >  383 & income_rank <= 383 ~ "Income deprived only",
      TRUE                                    ~ "Neither"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(deprivation_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n                   = n(),
    median_overall_rank = median(wimd_2025_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_worst20_overall = round(100 * mean(wimd_2025_rank <= 383), 1),
    pct_top50_overall   = round(100 * mean(wimd_2025_rank <= 50),  1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(median_overall_rank)

```

```{r}
master %>%
  count(rural_urban, drd_category) %>%
  group_by(rural_urban) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rural_urban, y = pct, fill = drd_category)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(n, "\n(", pct, "%)")),
    position  = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size      = 3.2,
    colour    = "white",
    fontface  = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "LSOAs never ranked in top 50 most deprived"    = "#74add1",
    "LSOAs sometimes in the top 50 most deprived"   = "#f46d43",
    "LSOAs often in the top 50 most deprived"       = "#d73027",
    "LSOAs in Deep-rooted deprivation"              = "#4d0000"
  )) +
  labs(
    title    = "Deep-Rooted Deprivation Category: Rural vs Urban LSOAs in Wales",
    subtitle = "WIMD persistence tracking (2005–2025). Persistent deprivation is\nalmost entirely concentrated in Urban areas.",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Percentage of LSOAs (%)",
    fill     = "Deprivation Persistence Category",
    caption  = "Source: WIMD 2025 Deep-Rooted Deprivation (Welsh Government); RUC 2021 (ONS). n = 1,917 LSOAs."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2))

```
